channel.title: GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社)
channel.description: GFIC Crew (GFIC歪果社) is a growing real-life social community for expats in China, founded by locals who know the country well. We meet up in person in Guangzhou and Shenzhen, and we run online groups plus a national group that expats in any Chinese city can join. We keep ten meetup formats on the board, from parties and networking mixers to food crawls, language exchange and weekend getaways.
